theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.logSumB_eq_neg_log {x : ℂ} {t : ℝ} {y₂ y₃ : ℂ} {φ : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hc₁ : 1 - ↑t / x ≠ 0) (hc₂ : 1 - y₂ / x ≠ 0) (hc₃ : 1 - y₃ / x ≠ 0) (hv₁ : x * (↑t + y₂ + y₃) = x ^ 2 + 1) (hv₂ : x * (↑t * y₂ + ↑t * y₃ + y₂ * y₃) = x ^ 2 + x + 1) (hv₃ : ↑t * y₂ * y₃ = 1) (hxim : 0 < x.im) (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (h2 : 0 < (y₂ / x).im) (hbig : Real.pi / 2 < φ → 0 < (y₃ / x).im) (hφ0 : 0 ≤ φ) (hφπ : φ < Real.pi) (hxarg : x.arg = φ) :
Complex.log (1 - ↑t / x) + Complex.log (1 - y₂ / x) + Complex.log (1 - y₃ / x) = -Complex.log x

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.eq_neg_log_of_branchInt_eq_zero {A x : ℂ} (h : Complex.exp (A + Complex.log x) = 1) (hk : ∀ (k : ℤ), A.im = -x.arg + 2 * Real.pi * ↑k → k = 0) :
A = -Complex.log x

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.exists_int_im_eq_add {A x : ℂ} (h : Complex.exp (A + Complex.log x) = 1) :
∃ (k : ℤ), A + Complex.log x = ↑k * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I) ∧ A.im = -x.arg + 2 * Real.pi * ↑k

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.branchInt_eq_zero_of_roots_B {x : ℂ} {t : ℝ} {y₂ y₃ : ℂ} {φ : ℝ} {k : ℤ} (hxim : 0 < x.im) (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (h2 : 0 < (y₂ / x).im) (hbig : Real.pi / 2 < φ → 0 < (y₃ / x).im) (hφ0 : 0 ≤ φ) (hφπ : φ < Real.pi) (h : (1 - ↑t / x).arg + (1 - y₂ / x).arg + (1 - y₃ / x).arg = -φ + 2 * Real.pi * ↑k) :
k = 0

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.sum_window_B {a₁ a₂ a₃ φ : ℝ} (hφ0 : 0 ≤ φ) (hφπ : φ < Real.pi) (h1lo : 0 < a₁) (h1hi : a₁ < Real.pi / 2) (h2lo : -Real.pi < a₂) (h2hi : a₂ ≤ 0) (h3lo : -Real.pi < a₃) (h3hi : a₃ ≤ Real.pi) (hbig : Real.pi / 2 < φ → a₃ ≤ 0) :
-φ - 2 * Real.pi < a₁ + a₂ + a₃ ∧ a₁ + a₂ + a₃ < -φ + 2 * Real.pi

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.arg_pos_real_root_div {x : ℂ} {t : ℝ} (hxim : 0 < x.im) (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
0 < (1 - ↑t / x).arg ∧ (1 - ↑t / x).arg < Real.pi / 2

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.im_div_otherRoots_snd_pos {c t : ℝ} (hc : c ≤ 1) (hcneg : c < 0) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (hp : unitCubic c t = 0) {x : ℂ} (hxre : x.re = c) (hxim : 0 < x.im) (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) :
0 < ((otherRoots (t - 2 * c) (t ^ 2 - 2 * c * t + 2 * c + 1)).2 / x).im

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.im_div_otherRoots_fst_pos {c t : ℝ} (hc : c ≤ 1) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (hp : unitCubic c t = 0) {x : ℂ} (hxre : x.re = c) (hxim : 0 < x.im) (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) :
0 < ((otherRoots (t - 2 * c) (t ^ 2 - 2 * c * t + 2 * c + 1)).1 / x).im

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.div_re_of_normSq_one {x y : ℂ} (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) :
(y / x).re = y.re * x.re + y.im * x.im

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.div_im_of_normSq_one {x y : ℂ} (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) :
(y / x).im = y.im * x.re - y.re * x.im

theorem QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDeformedSaddle.normSq_eq_one {x : ℂ} (hxnorm : x.re ^ 2 + x.im ^ 2 = 1) :
Complex.normSq x = 1
